title: The restricted augmented lift computes the cohomology h-map
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S′\to S$ be scheme morphisms, $F$ a module sheaf on $X$, $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $J$ an injective resolution of $(g′)^*F$, and $t:I\to g′_*J$ a complex map lifting the tensor-adjunction unit, with $g′$ the second pullback projection. For every $p\ge0$, open $V\subset S$ and choices $D:FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices(f,g,F,I,J,V)$, the constructed flatBaseChangeResolutionOpenMap equals moduleCohomologyFMap of the restricted projection h on $g′^{-1}(f^{-1}V)$ with map D.psi. No flatness is needed. The constructions are [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-open-map], [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], and [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap].

proof.text: Apply the restricted-lift sections theorem to obtain k, its augmentation equation and canonical comparison a, and the chain-level expression for qV.

Apply the generic augmented-lift cohomology formula to k. Expand the open-map definition, substitute the expression for qV, use functoriality of homology and cancel the source and target section comparison isomorphisms. This gives exactly the generic fixed-lift formula.

theorem flatBaseChangeRestrictedLift_homology {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (ht : I.ι.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
      (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g f))).unit.app F ≫
        (pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    flatBaseChangeResolutionOpenMap f g I J t p V D =
      moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p
